description.text: Property, real estate, and community association managers coordinate property operations, leasing, maintenance, budgets, and governance. See the O*NET 11-9141 tasks, 2025 United States wages, the BLS 2025–2035 projection, the Chinese wage gap, and the entry exercises.

title.text: Property, real estate, and community association managers

subject.name: Property, real estate, and community association managers
subject.summary: Property, real estate, and community association managers plan and coordinate the leasing, operations, maintenance, and governance of residential, commercial, or industrial property, communicate with owners, residents, association boards, and contractors, and manage budgets, contracts, and service records. Whether selling, buying, or leasing activities fall to them depends on the position and local rules.
